cohort.meaning: A difference between batches made under different conditions may come from those conditions. Context that is not recorded is not assumed equal.

comparison_summary.difference_definition: right batch minus left batch, at the same measured elapsed time

statistics.note: Descriptive only. Successive samples of one run are not independent, so no significance test is reported.

limitations: Descriptive comparison only. See the context check for product, process version, equipment, scale and stage.
Only exact elapsed-time matches are compared; no interpolation or aggregation.
data.time_basis: elapsed hours as supplied in the delivery; no clock or phase alignment inferred

verification.meaning: Read from the delivery files and not yet reviewed. Nothing here was accepted on a reviewer's behalf; verify the delivery before relying on these values.

result.summary: Compared 16 measured pairs. Uses values still in review.

timing.includes: authorization, retrieval, calculation and saving the result
